voice.description: Local-AI voice library id (sarosh, role-*, narrator-*). Never a cloud speaker for owner voice.

workspace.description: Absolute path under %LOCALAPPDATA%\AgentHub\media-studio or D:\Local-AI\data\artifacts. Never a product repo.

repositoryWritePolicy.description: Media workflows may inspect a source repository but never create, edit, delete, stage, or commit files there.

sourceRepository.description: Optional absolute product-repository path used strictly as read-only input.

productConfig.description: Optional absolute config path inside the external job workspace. A legacy repository config may be copied here but never created or updated in the repository.

bounceTo.description: Only series methodology leaves this studio. Product screencasts stay here and invoke the internal engine.

intent.description: viewer-facing (default) applies references/engagement.md. draft skips GPU plates but still writes for the ear.

emotionalTarget.description: One feeling at the payoff (relief, confidence, clarity). Empty means the writer must still infer one.

music.description: Program-level default. Per-scene musicCue on the screenplay can silence or sting over a bed.

deliveryProfile.description: Platform frame. briefing-board is the house 1600×1000 kit. See references/delivery-profiles.md.

craftScoreMin.description: Viewer-facing story-experience fail-closed threshold. Default 85. Draft ignores this gate.
